name: Data visualisation specialist
summary: Turns numbers into charts, infographics and slides that make one clear point without misleading anyone.

changelog.note: First release: role knowledge with 30 sources (WCAG 2.2 and W3C chart guidance, UK Analysis Function chart and colour rules, USWDS, FT Visual Vocabulary, Wilke, ColorBrewer, Vega-Lite 6 and Chart.js 4 docs), four skills, five prompts, two workflows, training interview and test briefs. Uses the three access levels.
